an5.218:1.3: Appasannā na ppasīdanti, pasannānañ ca ekaccānaṃ aññathattaṃ hoti, Satthu sāsanaṃ akataṃ hoti, pacchimā janatā diṭṭhānugatiṃ āpajjati, cittam assa na ppasīdati.
an5.218:1.4: Ime kho bhikkhave pañca ādīnavā apāsādike. 3.
an5.218:2.3: Appasannā pasīdanti, pasannānañ ca bhīyobhāvo hoti, Satthu sāsanaṃ kataṃ hoti, pacchimā janatā diṭṭhānugatiṃ āpajjati, cittam assa pasīdati.
an5.218:2.4: Ime kho bhikkhave pañca ānisaṃsā pāsādike
